name: refuse-sealed-void
why: A cutter stopping 0.004 mm short of the face it enters — the field defect behind the entry end of the cut rule in docs/GOTCHAS.md — used to return a watertight, unmanufacturable block with the tool sealed inside as a closed void. The cut now counts shells: a subtract that adds an internal void has removed nothing reachable, whatever the clearance measures, so there is no threshold to defend and the exactly-coincident and proud rows of the GOTCHAS table keep building. The message must name the void and the overshoot fix. B-rep only: the implicit backend has no topology, builds the membrane silently, and at 1 mm contouring cannot even represent it.

message_contains: proud of the material where it enters and past it where it exits
